products.title: DesignVue PD2706U 27-inch 4K UHD HDR Designer Monitor with Hotkey Puck G2
products.description: This BenQ DesignVue PD2706U is a 27-inch 4K UHD HDR designer monitor designed to provide optimal visual performance and comfort for creative professionals. It features an IPS panel with a 3840 x 2160 resolution and a 60 Hz refresh rate, delivering a clear and smooth picture. The monitor offers exceptional color accuracy with 95% DCI-P3, 99% sRGB, and 99% Rec. 709 gamuts, supporting 1.07 billion colors. It also features built-in KVM support, a customizable Hotkey Puck G2 for quick access to features, Picture-in-Picture (PIP) and Picture-by-Picture (PBP) modes for multitasking, and specialized viewing modes like CAD/CAM, Animation, and ePaper. TUV Rheinland Certified for Low Blue Light and Flicker-Free technologies, it ensures user eye comfort during long work sessions. The included adjustable arm stand allows for easy screen adjustment in rotation, height, tilt, and swivel. Additional features include intuitive color matching technology with Display ColorTalk and Palette Master Ultimate for precise calibration.

products.title: MA270S LED Monitor
products.description: The BenQ MA270S is a 27-inch 5K HDR monitor specifically designed for MacBook Pro and MacBook Air users.
